purpose: Anchor-binding verification: upgrade candidate anchors from coverage-consistency to formalized per-code binding tests. Mechanical evidence only; no contract claims.

in: Parse the official industry-classification PDF table (via committed -raw extract) into structured code->name->level->index entries for the T table and X/研究行业 table.
Per-code three-way comparison: PDF extract vs gbbq.zip!zhb.zip!incon.dat (TDXNHY/TDXRSHY sections) vs tdxzs3.cfg; plus field-token presence in tdxhy.cfg f2/f5 and tdxhy2.cfg f2/f3/f4.
Every mismatch listed per-code (code, PDF value, file value, diff type). Binding candidate requires zero UNEXPLAINED items (wording variants and documented asymmetries are explained classes).
Declared-vs-tabulated self-check: PDF states T 13/56/109 and X 30/128/352; compare against tabulated code counts.
GBBQ binding search: scan ALL staged official documents for any statement binding GBBQ binary record fields C1-C4 (order/unit/float32/rounding).
Explicit UNANCHORED list for items no source covers (A-share scope semantics, market/exchange field, tdxhy.cfg f1-f4 meanings).
out: No semantic contract claims; binding is graded (see strength_levels).
No new downloads. All inputs from /home/box/retained-inputs/ or committed derived extracts.
No src/ changes. No fitting, no new candidates.

pdf_parse.name: leading CJK/letter token run after code on same line; codeless continuation lines belong to the most recently seen code: digit-led lines contribute index tokens, CJK-led lines contribute a name only when the code lacks one
pdf_parse.display_alias_rule: tdxzs3.cfg names starting with 'TDX ' are level-1 aggregate display aliases -> NAME_DISPLAY_ALIAS (explained, not conflict)
pdf_parse.regions: T table between '通达信行业分为三个级别' and '研究行业分为三个级别' markers; X table from research-industry marker to '概念板块' marker

frozen_rules.unexplained_rule: a binding candidate passes only if every code in the union resolves to MATCH or an explained diff class; any unclassifiable diff is UNEXPLAINED and fails the candidate
frozen_rules.wording_variant_rule: names differing only by truncation, synonym, or class-suffix (类/其他) are NAME_WORDING_VARIANT — listed per-code, counted as explained

gbbq_binding_search.bind_test: a binding statement must name a binary member/record field AND its business meaning/unit; keyword presence alone is CLUE_ONLY

strength_levels.S1_CODE_SPACE_BOUND: PDF table declares the code space (codes+names+levels+index codes) — anchors what the namespace means
strength_levels.S2_DICT_AGREES: in-package dictionary covers the same namespace with consistent names/index codes (explained diffs allowed)
strength_levels.S3_FILE_FIELD_BINDING: tdxhy.cfg field values are a subset of the anchored code space — necessary but NOT sufficient to claim the field IS that namespace
